findings.description: The head builder appends Transfer-Encoding: chunked when the upstream was chunked and separately appends Content-Length from its parse, so the client head carries both. The body then consists of the upstream's raw chunk bytes cut at the Content-Length, so neither a TE client nor a CL client gets a well-framed body, and every chunked response is truncated. Precondition: any chunked upstream response.
findings.title: A chunked upstream response is forwarded with both Transfer-Encoding: chunked and a recomputed Content-Length, and the raw chunk bytes are then truncated to that length
